Modular Cathedral Kit V1.0
Created by SigilsVault — 08/03/2026
========================================

A modular fantasy cathedral kit built in Blender with a low-poly aesthetic inspired by GameCube/PS2-era games. 
Diffuse-only textures. 40+ pieces including 
walls, floors, ceilings, doors, pillars, stairs, and props.

CONTENTS
--------
- Modular Cathedral Pieces (GLB and FBX formats)
- Textures (256x256 up to 1024x1024)
- Trim sheet, diffuse and emission texture atlas for windows.
- LICENSE.txt

FORMATS
-------
GLB — Recommended. Textures are embedded, plug and play in most engines.
FBX — For users who need it. Textures must be applied manually.
      If your mesh appears black after import, assign the texture 
      from the provided Textures folder.

NOTES
-----
- For Unreal Engine and Unity users set grid snapping to 1 meter.
- All pieces are built to real world scale on a 1 meter grid.
- Some pieces such as window pieces have two material slots.
